title: MedDec: A Dataset for Extracting Medical Decisions from Discharge Summaries

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the distribution and percentage of annotated medical decision spans across protected patient variables (sex, race, and English proficiency) to identify data representation imbalances in the dataset.

Evaluating and comparing the predictive performance (F1 scores) of span detection models across 11 different patient phenotypic categories (e.g., heart disease, substance abuse, depression) to identify performance disparities.
